hero.title: General Contracting
hero.body1: Amr Ali Contracting & General Trading Company provides general contracting services for residential, commercial, administrative and industrial projects, through integrated solutions that cover every stage of construction, from site preparation and structural works to finishing and final handover.
hero.body2: We deliver projects through careful planning, coordination between engineering disciplines, and close follow-up of each stage of work, while adhering to the approved drawings, technical specifications and the agreed schedule.
hero.scopeLead: We provide integrated services for executing a wide range of structural and architectural works, tailored to the nature and requirements of each project.
scopePoints: Coordination and follow-up of execution and handover stages.

hero.title: Integrated Engineering Solutions from Concept to Execution
hero.subtitle: Engineering design services for residential, commercial, administrative, and industrial projects
hero.body1: Amr Ali For Contracting & General Trading provides engineering design services for residential, commercial, administrative, and industrial projects through 2D drawings, 3D designs and visualizations, with coordination between different disciplines to ensure design clarity and execution readiness.
hero.body2: We focus on providing designs that combine engineering accuracy, practical use, aesthetic appeal, and constructability.

design2D.title: 2D Engineering Designs
design2D.body: We prepare detailed engineering drawings and plans that clearly define project dimensions and technical details, providing a clear reference during execution.

design3D.title: 3D Designs & Visualizations
design3D.body: We transform drawings into visual representations that help clients see the project and understand its details before execution begins.
design3D.benefit: 3D design helps clients make better decisions regarding appearance, colors, materials, and space distribution before they are implemented on site.

architecturalDesign.body: We begin by understanding the project's requirements and intended use, then develop the design to achieve a balance between functionality and aesthetics.
